title: A Deep-DiD Method to Estimate Heterogeneous Treatment Effects: Application to Content Creator Selection
authors: Yan Cheng; Jingbo Wang; Xinyu Cao; Zuo-Jun Max Shen; Yuhui Zhang
eligible_reason: Methodological paper proposing a deep-neural-network DiD estimator of heterogeneous treatment effects. The replication package (code_for_release_blackandwhite) contains only PyTorch simulation scripts (figure_2..figure_6, table_1_hyperparameters), pre-generated simulated data (simulated_data/*.txt) and plotting code; there is no regression command and no empirical application data (the content-creator platform data are not shipped). No linear TWFE/event-study specification on real data can be identified, so no qualifying staggered binary design is recorded.
design_notes: Package = Monte Carlo simulations varying beta/fixed-effect strength, N, T, misspecification, and a random-forest comparison; outputs are PDF figures and a hyperparameter table. The empirical application (creator selection) is described only in the paper; its data and code are absent. The Deep-DiD estimator itself is a nonlinear (neural network) model, which would be excluded even if the application data were available.
estimators_reported: Deep-DiD (two deep neural networks embedded in a DiD framework) on simulated data
n_adoption_cohorts_note: not identifiable from the package (simulation only)

ineligible_specs.reason: simulation scripts for a nonlinear DNN estimator; no empirical regression

data_access_detail: Only simulated data (JSON in .txt files) are shipped; the platform data used in the empirical application are not included.
screener_notes: Full text not available; the abstract confirms this is a methods paper. If the published version reports a conventional TWFE benchmark on the creator data, it cannot be replicated from this package.
